caption: The drawing depicts a metal teapot with a tall, conical body and a wide, flared base, rendered in grayish-silver tones. The teapot has a curved spout on its left side, which extends outward and slightly upward, and a large, rounded handle attached to the upper right side of the vessel. The lid of the teapot is topped with a small, round golden knob. Decorative floral engravings, including several flower shapes and leafy stems, are etched onto the surface of the teapot's body. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. Near the bottom right of the image, the name "JOHN KOEHL" is printed in small, uppercase letters, and there are handwritten notations in light pencil below this text.
title: Coffee Pot
